answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through bonded staking, requiring every node to lock capital into an on-chain vault before participating in the peer nebula. The network penalizes detected equivocation by slashing escrowed deposits, forcing an attacker to pay a verifiable liquidity and capital opportunity cost per forged identity. However, this basalt economic floor risks plutocratic centralization, pricing out underfunded but honest agents.
